app.setup.title_default.why: Turkish suffix 'henüz' carries the 'not yet' nuance without a separate word for 'yet'; states the missing fact, not an instruction.

app.setup.title_failed.why: 'Belirsiz' (unclear) reads as hedged rather than 'off', keeping it distinct from the default title.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Bir site korumaya alındığında, tıklamalarınızı artık ele geçiremez.
app.setup.detail_default.back: A site protection-to when-taken, your-clicks anymore cannot seize.
app.setup.detail_default.why: 'Korumaya almak' (take under protection) is the natural Turkish verb for switching guarding on; 'artık' carries the 'no longer' without an antithesis frame.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Safari'den yanıt alınamadı. Uzantıyı açarsanız uygulama bunu kendiliğinden fark eder.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: From-Safari answer could-not-be-received. Extension-the if-you-open app this by-itself notices.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: 'Yanıt alınamadı' names the failure without an error code; 'kendiliğinden' reassures the app notices automatically.

app.setup.open_button.why: Names the exact destination the button opens; imperative verb, matches Apple's own button convention.

app.welcome.heading.why: Standard Turkish welcome formula; the one place allowed the warmer register.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Plain concrete noun phrase, no marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Görünmez bir katman dokunuşunuzu başka yere kaydırabilir.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: Invisible a layer your-tap other place-to can-shift.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Kept under budget by naming the effect (shifts your tap) rather than describing the layer's position in full.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Present-participle-as-adjective is native Turkish here, not a translated tail.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Bazı sayfalar bağlantıyı basışla bırakış arasında değiştirir.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some pages the-link press-with release between changes.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: 'Basışla bırakış arasında' names the exact moment without a subordinate clause.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Direct noun phrase matching the trick's name.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Koruma açıkken yeni sekme yalnızca bastığınız yere açılır.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: Protection on-while new tab only you-pressed place-to opens.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Stated as the promise the brief asks for, not as a description of the trick.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Uses the fixed vocabulary term 'hedef' for destination.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Gördüğü her hedefi listeler; sitede ya da her yerde izin verin ya da engelleyin.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: It-saw every destination lists; site-in or everywhere-in allow or block.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Semicolon splits the tracking claim from the allow/block choice without an English-style connector at the joint.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: 'Site bazında' is the standard Turkish phrase for a per-item setting.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Safari araç çubuğundaki Undirect düğmesine basmak o siteyi korumaya alır.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Safari toolbar-its-in Undirect button-to pressing that site-the protection-to takes.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: One subject-verb sentence names the exact mechanism, no separate clause for the outcome.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Two short words fit a narrow sidebar column and double as the nav title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Turkish term for this screen on both platforms.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated as the brief instructs.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Turkish has no single word for 'everywhere'; 'genel' (general) gives a true one-word label that still contrasts cleanly with 'Siteye Özel'.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Reads as the clear opposite of 'Genel' when the two sit side by side.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: Names this as a no-contact-yet state, distinct from an empty content list.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Safari'de bir sayfa açın, liste kendiliğinden dolar.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: In-Safari a page open, list by-itself fills.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: Imperative plus consequence in one short sentence, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Short and distinct in wording from the no-contact title above it.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Bir hedef, ancak siz karar verince listeye girer.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A destination, only you decision when-you-make list-to enters.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: 'Siz karar verince' (once you decide) makes clear a rule needs an actual decision, not just being seen.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Turkish has a single plural category (CLDR 'other'); the noun 'girişim' does not change form after the numeral.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: One-word passive verb form, the reused status word across the app.

app.rules.row.state_allowed.why: Single-word adjective, the clearest one-word opposite of 'Engellendi'.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Turkish has no single-word verb for 'allow'; 'izin ver' is the closest natural imperative and is used consistently for this action everywhere.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: Single imperative verb, fits the one-word budget exactly.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: Hedefi engelleyin ya da izin verin.
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: States the two available choices plainly, matching a hover tooltip's role.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the rule as returning to default, not as a new verdict.

app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that no site has been switched on yet.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Sorun çıkaran bir sitede Safari araç çubuğundaki Undirect düğmesine basın.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Trouble causing a site-on Safari toolbar-its-in Undirect button-to press.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Names the exact first action to take, matching the misbehaving-site framing in the brief.

app.watched.footer.s: Yeni site yalnızca Safari'deki düğmeyle eklenir.
app.watched.footer.back: New site only in-Safari button-with is-added.
app.watched.footer.why: States the one path to adding a site, since this screen has none of its own.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: One-word present-passive status, read-only on iOS.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb for a small trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes the button's effect plainly, matching a hover tooltip.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: One-word noun, the master switch's own name, kept consistent with the vocabulary's 'guard' concept.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic one-word on-state, reused for more than one setting.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Names the choice as a place (where it runs), matching the picker's actual options.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: The '-iniz' possessive suffix carries 'you' without stating a pronoun, matching the implied-second-person register.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Short two-word option naming automatic, everywhere coverage.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Uses the fixed vocabulary term 'not' for the page-note feature.

app.settings.policy_heading.why: Names exactly what the default governs: destinations with no rule at all.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Matches the imperative verb used for the same policy elsewhere in the app.

app.settings.policy_allow.why: Matches the paired imperative used for the allow policy elsewhere.

ext.meta.description.s: Sayfaların tıklamanızı ele geçirip istemediğiniz yere yönlendirmesini engeller.
ext.meta.description.back: Pages-of your-click seizing-and you-didn't-want place-to their-redirecting blocks.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for a reader who has never used the extension, naming both the seizure and the unwanted redirect.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name is the product's own name.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the current on-state for the active tab's site.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action, since pressing this icon is how guarding starts.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains briefly that there is nothing here to guard.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Short headline for the empty-tab state, sits beside a small icon.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Bir site açın, ardından buraya basın.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: A site open, then here-to press.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: 'Buraya' keeps the brief's instruction to self-reference the button as 'here' rather than a place.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label naming exactly what the switch controls.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: States plainly why the switch is disabled: nothing to guard.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because everywhere mode already covers it.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Attributes the disabled switch to the master setting, not this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.why: States current state then the reload warning as a separate short sentence.

ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Two-word heading sitting beside the trailing stopped-count badge.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Koruma kapalı olduğu için burada bir şey izlenmiyor.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Protection off being because here a thing is-not-tracked.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22; wording matches the voice of the other page-section states in case it is wired up later.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Bu sayfa henüz başka bir yere uzanmadı.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page yet other a place-to hasn't-reached.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing has tried to reach outside this page so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key; treated as a near-synonym of page_quiet per the brief, worded around the empty list itself.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Turkish has one plural category; the same phrase serves the count of 1 and any other count.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Identical to stopped_one: Turkish nouns do not change after a numeral, so both forms of this plural pair read the same.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Broader than 'stopped': counts every recorded attempt, blocked and allowed.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Same phrase as seen_one; no Turkish plural inflection applies after the number.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse fragment meant to sit among other short tags in one detail line.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same phrase as tries_one; Turkish's single plural category needs no second form.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Reads naturally as the lead-in half of 'Uygulanan düzeltme: <isim>'.

ext.state.blocked.why: Same one-word status as app.rules.row.state_blocked, kept consistent across surfaces.

ext.state.removed.why: Names the trap as taken off the page, distinct from an allow/block verdict.

ext.scope.here.why: Fragment meant to follow a verdict word; the fixed `${verdict} ${scope}` concatenation puts it after, not before, which is not the most natural Turkish order but is unavoidable given the hardcoded composition.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Same composition caveat as scope.here applies.

ext.scope.default.why: Names 'no explicit rule, only the general default' as a trailing fragment.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Location before verb is the natural Turkish order, unlike the scope fragments above which are fixed by code.

ext.action.allow_everywhere.why: Same natural order as allow_here, scope word placed first.

ext.action.block_here.why: Natural Turkish order, distinct menu option from the everywhere variant.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Natural Turkish order, paired with block_here.

ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same wording as app.settings.policy_heading, kept consistent across the two surfaces.

ext.policy.block.why: Matches the block imperative used consistently elsewhere.

ext.policy.allow.why: Matches the allow imperative used consistently elsewhere.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Bu sayfa uzantının bir kısmını engelliyor, koruma burada eksik kalıyor.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page extension-of a part-its is-blocking, protection here incomplete stays.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Attributes the block to the page's own settings, names the result as partial protection, not a bug.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short noun-phrase tag matching its siblings' shape.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than click_catcher: any see-through element, not specifically a clickable one.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own script made up, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Short tag for a window the page's own script opened.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Adds 'anlık' (instant) to distinguish this from the general 'Değişen Bağlantılar' welcome-screen title.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names the redirect as tied to the back gesture specifically.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab-redirect trick as one that hijacks the click.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Distinguishes a tab-under from a normal window.open pop-up.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names this as the earliest, strongest kind of block.

ext.reason.way_back.why: States the specific sign treated as legitimate: a return path in the address itself.

ext.reason.sized.why: Names the deliberate-size signal that reads as an intentional secondary window.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short footnote naming the core hijack pattern the extension exists to stop.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Attributes the allow to the general default policy, not a specific rule.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Names the site's own code as the one vouching for the window.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: One word, reused as the nav row, the screen's own header, and the back-button label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names the popup's main per-site view as the back-button's destination, since the visible button shows only a chevron.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Two-word budget allows the direct phrase, unlike the one-word grouping filter elsewhere.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Clear counterpart to 'Her Yerde' in the same list.

ext.action.allow.why: Scope is already fixed by the section, so this is the plain allow verb.

ext.action.block.why: Plain block verb, scope fixed by section.

ext.action.clear.why: Same action and wording as app.rules.row.use_default.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: One word, matches Apple's term; reused as nav row and header title.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Same word as app.settings.guard_toggle, used both as visible label and sr-only label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: Matches app.settings.state_on for the same concept.

ext.action.report.why: Names the action of opening a pre-filled issue report, submission still left to the person.
